# Riverside City College

> Riverside City College is a comprehensive community college offering affordable degree programs, certificates, and transfer pathways with a commitment to equity and student success.

RCC, part of the Riverside Community College District, serves students in California with diverse academic programs spanning technical trades, business, education, health sciences, and the arts. As a Hispanic-Serving Institution founded in 1916, RCC emphasizes affordability, institutional effectiveness, and inclusive learning.
